AGRICULTURE — TERMLY EXAM #10
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Milk souring
   D. Ice melting to water

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Crop Protection: Pest control? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Crop Protection: Pest control.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Protection: Pest control.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Crop Protection: Pest control.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Crop Protection: Pest control.

3. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Burning crop residue every week

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Inorganic fertilisers? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Inorganic fertilisers.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Inorganic fertilisers.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Inorganic fertilisers.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Inorganic fertilisers.

5. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Producers
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Decomposers only
   D. Primary consumers only

6. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animal Health: Parasite control? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animal Health: Parasite control.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animal Health: Parasite control.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animal Health: Parasite control.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Animal Health: Parasite control.

8. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. watt (W)
   C. joule (J)
   D. newton (N)

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Rearing Selected Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Rearing Selected Animals.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Rearing Selected Animals.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Rearing Selected Animals.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Rearing Selected Animals.

10. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 37 °C

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Structures in Animal production? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Structures in Animal production.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Structures in Animal production.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Structures in Animal production.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Structures in Animal production.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Livestock Products? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Livestock Products.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Livestock Products.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Livestock Products.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Livestock Products.

13. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Glucose and oxygen

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Digestive systems of animals? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Digestive systems of animals.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Digestive systems of animals.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Digestive systems of animals.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Digestive systems of animals.

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Agroforestry? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Agroforestry.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Agroforestry.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Agroforestry.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Agroforestry.

16. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. A mixture of two liquids

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Agroforestry and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Crop Protection: Pest control and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Crop Production Structures and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Digestive systems of animals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Animal Health: Parasite control and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Structures in Animal production and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
